verdict.rationale: Docs confirm every processing endpoint supports both sync and async modes (extend-docs-37) and pricing page lists a 'Fast mode' option (extend-docs-25), implying a fast synchronous path exists, but no evidence quantifies actual latency (e.g., 'returns in X seconds') for either mode. Missing for 10: documented latency benchmarks per mode, explicit performance numbers for sync/fast mode, independent confirmation of response times.
